text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.orig_text:
とある週末、イオと{0}は
ルーセント学院の授業参観で行う調理実習のため、
その食材の買い出しを行っていた。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I'm in a dilemma...
Everything looks so good, I just can't make up my mind.
Hey, what do you think we should buy?
text_block_list.orig_text:
んー、
困ったわ……
どれも美味しそうで、
目移りしちゃう。
ねえ、
君はどれがいいと思う？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Hey! That doesn't help at all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう！　
君までそんなこと言わないでよ～！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
I really hope the students can learn to enjoy the culinary arts more
through the upcoming cooking session.
text_block_list.orig_text:
生徒のみんなには、
今回の調理実習を通じて
料理するのが好きになってもらえるとうれしいと思ってるの。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
But to achieve that, we'll need to gather up some delicious ingredients.
So let's put our heads together and think.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そのためにも美味しい食材を揃えなきゃいけないんだから、
君も一緒に
よく考えて。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Still, although you're not from my class,
it's very helpful having you here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
けど、
君とは違うクラスのだっていうのに、
付き合ってくれて助かっちゃった。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Buying ingredients for the whole class
would be really tough for me to do on my own.
text_block_list.orig_text:
一クラス分の食材を買わなくちゃいけないから、
先生一人じゃ大変で
困っていたの。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, even though we're just grocery shopping,
I'm having lots of fun because I'm with you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
調理実習の買い出しなのに、
君と一緒だから
とっても楽しい。

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Hello there!
Are you two lovebirds preparing for a cooking date at home tonight?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いらっしゃい。
お姉さんたち、
これからお家で
手料理デートかい？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Wha—?! It's nothing like that.
He's one of my students, and we're just
buying ingredients for a cooking session at school.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ！　
私たちそんなんじゃ。
彼は私の教え子で、
今日は調理実習の買い出しです。

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Oh what, you're a teacher?
You two seem so close, I totally assumed you were a couple.
You must get that a lot, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだ、
先生だったのかい？
あんまり仲良く買い物してたから、
てっきりカップルかと思ったよ。
よく言われるだろ？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we do get told that often...
But I wonder if we really do seem that way.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ、
よく言われますけど……
けど、
私たちって本当にそんな風に見えるのかな？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Wait. \"That way\"... As in... like you're my boyfriend.
I mean, it would be nice if my first partner
was someone kind like you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ？　
そんな風って……
それは……
君が私の彼氏だってこと。
確かに、
初めての彼氏は
君みたいな優しい人がいいけど……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
But we're just teacher and student...
Right? You think the same, don't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
私たちは先生と生徒だし……
ね？　
君だってそう思うでしょ……？

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Well, if that's what makes you two happy.
Putting that aside, it seems like you're having a bit of trouble.
If you want, shall I help you choose some ingredients?
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ、
二人がよければなんでもいいけどさ。
それで先生、
ずいぶん迷ってるみたいだけど、
よかったら
おすすめの食材を見繕ってあげようか？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Yes, that'd be great...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ、
お願いします～……

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: All right, leave it to me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし、
まかしときな！

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Here! Sorry for the wait!
text_block_list.orig_text:
へい、
お待ちどうさん！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Wha—? This much?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ？　
こんなに？

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
So the name on the receipt is... \"Lucent Academy.\"
Thank you, guys!
text_block_list.orig_text:
領収書のあて名は、
ルーセント学院っと。
まいどありー！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
...We bought too much!
But I'm sure the principal will reimburse us, so it should be fine, right...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
買い過ぎちゃったー！
学院長から予算はもらってるし、
きっと平気だよね……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's say it's fine. But even with the parents joining in,
we won't be able to use up all the ingredients in one session.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それはいいとして、
保護者も集まるけど、
一回の調理実習じゃ
こんなに使い切れないわ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Since we bought so much food, we shouldn't let it go to waste.
...I've got it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
せっかく買った食材を余らせちゃうのはよくないし、
……
そうだっ！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's start practicing for the cooking session.
For some reason, going grocery shopping with you makes me wanna cook.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ということで、
調理実習の練習を始めます。
なんだか
君と買い物してたら、
料理したくなっちゃってたの。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Hey, {0}! What's with that worried look on your face?
You're thinking that I can't cook, aren't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
君！　
その不安そうな顔は、
どうしてかしら？
先生のこと、
料理できないって思ってるんでしょ～？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to say, but even I can cook, okay?
Well, I'm not great at it, but now that I'm an adult living alone,
I can cook to some degree. Trust me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
残念だけど、
私だって料理くらいできるんだから！
得意ってわけじゃないけど、
社会人になってから一人暮らしを始めたし、
ある程度は作れるの。
本当よ？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Sooo, you can just sit and watch.
I'm going to absolutely blow your mind
with the food I'm going to serve you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから、
君は座って見てて。
きっと驚くくらい美味しい料理を食べさせてあげるね。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Ah, not like that!
Now we really do look like a couple having a cooking date at home!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううん、
そうじゃなくて！
これじゃ本当にお家で手料理を作ってるカップルみたいじゃない！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
All we're doing here is cooking practice!
On the day of, I'll need to cook while teaching the students, right?
So today we'll rehearse by using up all the excess ingredients!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今からするのは
調理実習の練習！
当日は生徒のみんなに教えながら料理を作らないといけないでしょ？
買い過ぎちゃった分の食材を使って、
その練習をするのが目的よ！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Anyways!
Just leave it to me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
とにかく！
ここは先生にまかせて。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Lalalala~! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text: ふんふんふ～ん♪

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Hmm?
Oookay... Nngh! Huh?
This veggie... It's so hard, I can't cut through it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？
よいっしょ……
んん～！　
あれ～？
このお野菜、
とっても固くて切れないわ～

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no.
Right now, I'm supposed to be showing you how to cook instead.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それはダメよ。
今は、
先生がお手本を見せてるところなんだから。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Nnnngh!
...Oh, it's just no use.
text_block_list.orig_text:
んん～！
……
やっぱり無理だわ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
I really can't seem to cut this,
so I guess I'll need your help just this one time.
Here, take the knife. Be careful, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
私じゃ切れそうにないし、
今回だけはお願いしちゃおうかしら。
はい、
包丁。
気を付けてね？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Wow, oh gosh!
I know I told you to just sit earlier, but I guess I do need your help after all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごい、
さすがね！
さっきは座っててって言ったけど、
やっぱり手伝ってもらおうかな。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm glad you said that.
Just as I thought, you're really reliable.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
そう言ってくれてうれしいな。
やっぱり君は頼りになるね。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
All right, you're in charge of this knife.
Here, take this.
Next, please cut the fruits for the garnishes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、
君を包丁係に任命します。
はい、
これ。
次は付け合せのフルーツをお願い。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Oh no!
You squirted me with the juice! I'm soaking wet from head to toe!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんっ！
中から果汁が～！　
全身びしょびしょだわ～！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
You got it all over yourself too.
We can't have you getting sick, so let me wipe it off for you.
Come over here. Just like that... *wipe, wipe*
text_block_list.orig_text:
君もいっぱい濡れちゃったね。
風邪ひいちゃいけないし、
拭いてあげるね。
ほら、
こっち来て。
こうして……
ふきふき。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
All right, next, help wipe my body. Hey, come on. Hurry up, okay?
If you don't, I'm going to catch a cold.
And also, the juice is getting all sticky... It's really uncomfortable.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
次は
私の身体を拭いて～
ねえ、
ほら。
早くして？
このままじゃ先生、
風邪ひいちゃうわ～
それに
果汁でベタベタしてて……
なんだか変な感じなの～

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! That tickles!
Hahaha... Can you... please just do it properly?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひゃんっ！　
くすぐったいわ～！
あはは、
ちょっと
真面目にやってよ～

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Hey! I'm still in the middle of cooking, you know?
Now we really seem like a couple fooling around...
text_block_list.orig_text:
もうっ！　
料理の途中だって分かってる？
これじゃ
本当にカップルが遊んでるみたいじゃない……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Thank you—it's all good!
I'm all cleaned up now!
Okay, let's get back to cooking!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう、
もう大丈夫よ！
きちんと拭けました！
さ、
料理に戻ろう！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
And we're done!
It's all thanks to you. You've been so helpful.
text_block_list.orig_text:
かんせーい！
君が手伝ってくれて、
すっごく助かっちゃった。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
The teacher's performance will be important in the real session too.
If you don't mind, can you help on the day of as well?
text_block_list.orig_text:
調理実習も手際のよさが大切よね。
良かったら、
当日も手伝ってくれない？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Thanks! 
Oh, if only we could always cook together like this, every day would be so much fun.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やった！　
ありがと！
こんな風に
いつも一緒に料理を作れたら、
きっと毎日楽しいわよね～

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Um, never mind!
Okay then, I'll see you on Parents' Day!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！　
ううん、
なんでもない！
じゃあ、
当日はよろしくね！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: All right, everyone, are you all seated?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はいみんなー、
席に着いたー？

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Yes!
text_block_list.orig_text: はーい！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Okay, let's start cooking.
After you finish, we'll share your tasty treats with your parents.
So good luck, and pour your hearts into them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
調理実習を始めます。
作った料理は、
あとで保護者のみなさんと一緒に食べるから、
一生懸命、
心をこめて作ろうね。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
First, we'll prepare some as an example for you, so watch carefully.
All right, {0}, let's start with cutting the vegetables.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まずは、
お手本として先生が準備するから、
よーく見ててね。
じゃあ、{0}君、
お野菜から切っていこうか。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, are you watching closely?
You'll have to cut like him.
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな、
見てるかしら？
彼みたいに切っていくのよ～

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Okayyy!
text_block_list.orig_text: はーーーい！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, they're so focused on following your example.
Well, as a teacher, I need to show them my skills as well... Here goes!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
みんな真面目にお手本を見ていて偉いわ。
私も
先生として、
ちゃんといいところ見せないと……
よいしょっ！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Ahhhh!
My eyes are tearing up! Silly onions!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ～ん！
目に染みる～！　
玉ねぎさんが～！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Ohh, thank you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
う～、
ありがとう～

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Your eyes are bright red too.
Let me wipe yours.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら？　
君も目が真っ赤だよ。
私も拭いてあげる。

text_block_list.name: Female Student
text_block_list.text:
Iooo, question!
When you said you'd be setting an example, you didn't mean about cooking, but being a married couple, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
イオちゃーん、
しつもーん！
お手本って、
料理のことじゃなくて夫婦のことだったの～？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.orig_text: えっ？

text_block_list.name: Female Student
text_block_list.text:
Well, you two
look just like my dad and my mom cooking at home.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だってイオちゃんたち、
うちのパパとママがお家で料理してるみたいだったもん。

text_block_list.name: Female Student's Mother
text_block_list.text: Oh my! Please excuse my child!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらやだ！　
うちの子ったら！

text_block_list.name: Female Student's Father
text_block_list.text: Hey, no more allowance for you if you keep saying strange things like that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっと、
それ以上変なこと言ったら、
お小遣いなしにするぞ～？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: No, we're not like that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいえっ、
私たちはそんなんじゃなくて～

text_block_list.name: Female Student
text_block_list.text:
But it looks like it!
You're just like my parents!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
そう見えたよ～
うちのママたちみたい～！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Well, just say we're like a regular couple instead!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もうっ！　
それを言うならカップルでしょ～？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that isn't right either!
You should stop laughing and say something too, {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
それも違うわよ！
君も笑ってないで、
何か言ってよ～！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
While being bombarded with questions regarding their relationship,
they all finished eating the dishes, and Parents' Day was finally over.
text_block_list.orig_text:
イオたちは二人の関係についての質問の集中砲火を浴びながら、
調理実習で作った料理を食べ終えて、無事に授業参観を終える。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Days later, their school principal gave them a lecture about going over the budget.
text_block_list.orig_text: 後日、学院長から使い過ぎた予算について注意を受けたのだった。
